feature: Phase 2D1 optional recursive folder input with relative output directories

capabilities.deterministicOrder: StringComparer.Ordinal; current platform path casing and real file identity deduplication
capabilities.recursiveOutputRoot: explicit existing local directory; may be a source descendant that is excluded; cannot equal/contain source root
capabilities.excludedLocations: chosen output subtree; actual configured portable data (including scratch/logs); validated ownership-journal/marker candidate directories
capabilities.redirectedDirectoryPolicy: reject the whole recursive addition before acceptance; never traverse
capabilities.acceptanceCancellationBoundary: before acceptance: no added rows; during later automatic inspection: accepted rows remain
capabilities.relativeDestination: output root / validated relative parent / <source basename>.trimmed.mkv; no source-root-name prefix
capabilities.directoryPreparation: Infrastructure only, before candidate reservation for an approved OutputDirectoryRoot; single-file missing-parent policy unchanged
capabilities.cleanup: owned candidate/journal lifecycle unchanged; empty prepared output directories may remain after failure/cancellation

localVerification.testCorrection: One initial headless assertion directly set a workspace gate that Main immediately recomputed. The test now uses the authoritative Main busy state; no production fix was made for that test setup.

realMedia.method: Production recursive discovery -> accepted immutable folder origins -> independent backend inspections and manual plan approvals -> aggregate Review -> existing sequential BatchCoordinator/JobCoordinator pipeline. mkvextract compares complete five retained VP8/PCM/SRT representations plus two attachments; backend verifies supported metadata/flags/XML/timestamps.
realMedia.fixtureRecipe: Copy original ordinary.mkv to Season 1/episode.mkv; derive original track identities by inspection; create Season 2/episode.mkv with pinned mkvmerge --disable-track-statistics-tags and order subtitle, second audio, video, first audio. A keeps video/second audio/subtitle; B keeps video/first audio.
realMedia.limits: Generated B container hashes/worker PIDs vary between fixture runs. Exited retained process handles establish normal completed worker exit, not active cancellation. Controlled filesystem failures are not a real media/tool failure fixture.

portable.effectiveScale: not observed; no display setting changes

Final evidence-only CI links belong in PR #7.

native.method: Installed Computer Use @oai/sky UIA/keyboard, no screenshots; owner assists established untargetable tab/system-picker input.
native.scope: Owner-assisted functional Windows 10 recursive-folder workflow; UIA/keyboard evidence, not native appearance or clean target-platform acceptance.
ownerAssistance: Opening the Several files / folder tab in the isolated copy.
Accepting the prepared existing output root and the two-season source root in the actual native folder pickers.
Selecting the Season 1 path text after a first row handoff left Season 2 selected and excluded. Computer Use restored inclusion before continuing.
native.computerUseActions: Observed-focus keyboard input enabled recursion, edited/approved both independent plans, switched EN -> RU -> EN, performed aggregate Review and started the queue. No CLI remux or direct ViewModel/API execution substituted for the native run.
native.defaultAndSettingObservability: The new label/help and empty startup were observed. UIA does not expose ToggleState, so default-off/current-checkbox identity and its EN/RU preservation are not directly established natively. Default-off/preservation pass headless tests; actual nested discovery establishes effective recursive input for this addition.
native.languageSwitch: Passed observed EN -> RU -> EN labels/help, the selected Season 1 source/destination/approved choice, two included entries and both plans/destinations in the subsequent aggregate Review. Original Matching audio/Captions titles and language metadata remained original; no automatic operation started.
native.result: All reviewed items finished. Original files remain intact. / 2 files · 2 included · 2 finished; Start/Cancel disabled after completion.
native.transientStageObservation: Not run: the two small jobs finished before the next settled UIA read; this native receipt does not establish observation of every intermediate progress stage or worker interval. Sequential/no-overlap lifecycle is tested separately.

independentOutputVerification.method: Read-only production MkvBackend verification plus complete pinned mkvextract SHA256 comparisons, using the separately observed GUI-approved source IDs; no remux/publication or UI calls.

native.independentVerifier: A task-local read-only console referenced the same production MkvBackend and called VerifyAsync against the separately observed GUI-approved plans. It then used the package's pinned mkvextract modes/whole-file SHA256 method from MediaPayloadEvidence for five tracks and two attachments. It never called remux, publication or UI commands. Auditor payload files are retained outside the portable application's data tree; application scratch is empty.
infrastructureLimits: Known capture/coordinate-input and system-picker field limitations were not retried. Owner picker input is recorded explicitly; no screenshot/layout/focus-visibility/scaling result is claimed.

UIA sometimes returned stale focus/text or accessibility:null. After the early navigation deviation, activating inputs used separately confirmed settled focus; timeouts were followed by observation, not blind repetition.

A small task-local JavaScript wrapper validates the current observed focus and records supported @oai/sky key/observation calls. It is not a production API and cannot supply missing native picker capabilities.
navigationDeviations: An early Space based on an intermediate focus read opened Add Folder before the intended recursion change. That picker was cancelled; no rows, plans or media work resulted. Later recursion input used confirmed checkbox focus.

The first owner row-selection handoff left Season 2 excluded and still selected. A fresh read showed the explicit Excluded entry; Computer Use restored it, confirmed two included files, and the owner then selected Season 1 by its path text. Aggregate Review included both original plans.
